demo.title: hyperliquid-agent.txt
demo.code:
You:   what is my Hyperliquid account worth?
Agent: hyperliquid --format json account portfolio
       equity $12,480.55 · withdrawable $3,200.00 · 2 positions

You:   buy 0.01 BTC with a limit at 96,000
Agent: hyperliquid --format json --dry-run orders create --coin BTC --side buy --price 96000 --size 0.01
       Preview: BUY 0.01 BTC @ 96000 · asset 0 · size precision 5 · builder fee 0.001% · mainnet
       Executes: an Order action signed by your OWS wallet
       Want me to place it?

You:   yes
Agent: hyperliquid --format json orders create --coin BTC --side buy --price 96000 --size 0.01 --yes
       oid 4815162342 · resting

setup: Pick a signer: `hyperliquid wallet create` for an encrypted local vault, or `hyperliquid wallet login` for a Bankr hosted wallet used with `--bankr`
Install this skill, then say `what is my Hyperliquid account worth?` to check reads
Rehearse on testnet with `hyperliquid --testnet ...` before the first live order; every mutation has a `--dry-run` preview
